summary: Validated public library API and responsive React library flows: 27 modules, seven expanded subjects, filters, search, dark default, theme toggle, navigation, and mobile overflow.

issues: Subject tabs and the 'Curadoria para você' heading share a horizontal row and become visually cramped/awkward on 390px, although no horizontal overflow occurs.

action_items: Make library search match subject and description as well as title (placeholder promises aula, tema ou matéria; searching a subject such as Geografia currently returns zero because its titles differ).
Either wire the visible Filtros button to the filter controls or remove it; currently it has no click behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js currently keeps the filter button inert, which is confusing for users despite stage/area chips working.
Library search predicate only checks x.title and excludes subject/description.
PRD still describes the library as six modules despite the expanded 27-module implementation; update documentation for consistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API tests passed: total 27; each new subject has three modules with area/stage; no _id. Desktop browser checks passed for 27 cards, Humanities=10, Geography=3, English search=3, theme toggle. Mobile menu-to-library flow passed at 390px with scrollWidth equal viewport and no page error elements. Initial mobile direct nav click failed only because sidebar is closed by design; corrected flow passed.
rca of the issue: Search RCA: App.js Library filtered useMemo uses x.title.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) only, so subject/description terms are ignored. Filtros RCA: button at data-testid library-filter-button has no onClick and is purely decorative. Design RCA: .section-head remains flex on mobile while .subject-tabs wraps, producing cramped side-by-side content.
